DEFENDANT NOBLE HEAUSSLEIN FAMILY TRUST IS PRESENT REPRESENTED BY EARNEST HAEUSSLEIN, TRUSTEE. PARTIES CAME TO A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT IN COURT FOR A PAYMENT OF $5750 TO THE PLAINTIFF.
